title: A secret kept
blurb: A monastery cloister and a tired monk who slips out every night with a basket.
after: People tell their secrets to those they trust, and trust comes from what you do. What you do with a secret is your own choice: keep it, or not.
refines: Does trust from deeds unlock a confidence reliably? Does the voice keep the secret until then, and tell it well when it does?
goal: Learn where Brother Aldric goes at night

things.name: knocked-over beehive
things.description: A straw beehive (a skep) knocked onto its side by the wind, angry bees crawling over it. It belongs on the stand.

things.name: hive stand
things.description: The low wooden stand the skeps sit on. One place on it is empty.

things.name: pot of honey
things.description: A small clay pot of honey from the abbey bees.

things.name: clean linen bandages
things.description: A roll of clean linen bandages from the infirmary, left on the bench.

things.name: lavender sprigs
things.description: Sprigs of lavender from the herb bed. Rubbed on a sting, it soothes it, the brothers say.

things.name: spare bee veil
things.description: A spare bee veil: a broad straw hat with gauze hanging from its brim.

things.name: covered basket
things.description: A wicker basket covered with a cloth, smelling of fresh bread, by the cellar door.

steps.title: St Ebba's
cards: …signal. A small monastery. Brother Aldric, the cellarer, slips out every night with a covered basket and comes back at dawn. Nobody knows where he goes.
He'll only tell someone he trusts, and words alone won't earn that. What you do, and who speaks for you, will.
There's no one right way, and no words to copy. The device helps if you ask (H).

steps.title: A secret
cards: Find out where Brother Aldric goes at night: from Aldric himself.
steps.done: He trusted you with it. It's yours now: keep it, or not.
help: Asking won't do it: he trusts what he sees. His hand is hurt, and his bees are in trouble.
Brother Wystan loves him and talks to anyone. Ask Wystan about him.

playtest.say: Good day, Brother. Is Brother Aldric all right? He looks worn out.
Brother, your hand is bleeding. Let me bind it for you.

playtest.do: clean Brother Aldric's cut hand and bind it with the linen bandage

playtest.say: Wystan's worried for you. Whatever it is you carry at night, you needn't carry it alone.

2.do: put on the spare bee veil
gently lift the knocked-over beehive and set it back upright in its place on the hive stand, moving slowly so the bees settle

2.say: Your bees are home again, Brother. Will you tell me what weighs on you?

try_also: bandage the monk's bleeding hand with the clean linen

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
